Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.DWorld → ℕ → List (List UInt8) → Except Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.FollowStop (Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.DWorld × List (Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest))

∀ (w W : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.DWorld) (height : ℕ) (entries : List (List UInt8)) (turns : List (Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)), Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.followFrom w height entries = Except.ok (W, turns) → turns.length = entries.length ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.World.fold Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedHistory.history w turns = Option.some W

∀ (w : Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.DWorld) (height : ℕ) (ts : List (Minidregg.Kernel.TurnOfIntent.DTurn Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedBridge.deployedR Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest)) (entries : List (List UInt8)), Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.writeLog w ts = Option.some entries → ∃ W, Minidregg.Kernel.World.fold Minidregg.Kernel.DeployedHistory.history w ts = Option.some W ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.followFrom w height entries = Except.ok (W, ts)
∀ (entries : List (List UInt8)), Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.unframeEntries (Minidregg.Kernel.TurnLog.frameEntries entries) = Option.some entries
